parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, screening, facility, or custody rule is documented, and private same-sex conduct is legal, so this is not severe/catastrophic. But public same-sex affection carries months-to-years penalties, and a local civil-society report documents false-accusation arrests plus law-enforcement mistreatment and torture of LGBTQ people. Societal discrimination against transgender people is described as entrenched, with no protections, recourse, known organisations, or documented trans acceptance. Harsh prison and impunity conditions make consequences if outed severe. The absence of trans-specific incident data is not evidence of safety; the rating extrapolates from criminalisation, enforcement abuse, hostile climate, and failed protection.
